user_query: Identify the enzyme and explain its catalytic activity. Retrieve the best curated Swiss-Prot homolog evidence, catalytic reaction/equation, cofactors, pathway, localization, and relevant domains. Clearly distinguish direct curated evidence from homology-based inference.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.

function: Aspartyl-tRNA synthetase with relaxed tRNA specificity since it is able to aspartylate not only its cognate tRNA(Asp) but also tRNA(Asn). Reaction proceeds in two steps: L-aspartate is first activated by ATP to form Asp-AMP and then transferred to the acceptor end of tRNA(Asp/Asn).
